==English==
[[File:US Navy 081029-N-4954I-002 Chief Aircrew Survival Equipmentman Rob Ramsey calculates flight times.jpg|thumb|250px|upright|Papers and calculators are common tools for calculation.]]

===Etymology===
{{ety|en|:bor|la:calculō|tree=1}}
{{bor+|en|la|calculātus}}, {{glossary|perfect}} {{glossary|passive}} {{glossary|participle}} of {{m|la|calculō||to reckon, compute, calculate|pos=originally by means of pebbles}} (see {{af|en|-ate|id1=verb|pos1=verb-forming suffix}}), from {{m|la|calculus||a pebble}}, further from {{af|la|calx|-ulus|t1=limestone|pos1=''calc-'' in compounds|pos2=forms diminutives|nocat=1}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ˈkælkjʊleɪt/|/ˈkælkjəleɪt/}}
* {{audio|en|en-us-calculate.ogg|a=US}}
* {{hyphenation|en|cal|cu|late}}

===Verb===
{{en-verb}}

# {{lb|en|transitive|mathematics}} To determine the value of something or the solution to something by a mathematical process.
#: {{ux|en|'''Calculate''' the square root of 3 to 10 decimal places.}}
# {{lb|en|intransitive|mathematics}} To determine values or solutions by a mathematical process; [[reckon]].
# {{lb|en|intransitive|US|dialect}} To plan; to expect; to think.
#* {{RQ:Lincoln Pratt's Patients|chapter=1|passage=I stumbled along through the young pines and huckleberry bushes. Pretty soon I struck into a sort of path that, I '''cal’lated''', might lead to the road I was hunting for. It twisted and turned, and, the first thing I knew, made a sudden bend around a bunch of bayberry scrub and opened out into a big clear space like a lawn.}}
# To ascertain or predict by mathematical or astrological computations the time, circumstances, or other conditions of; to forecast or compute the character or consequences of.
#: {{co|en|to '''calculate''' or cast one’s nativity}}
#* {{RQ:Shakespeare Henry 6-2|IV|i|passage=A cunning man did '''calculate''' my birth.}}
# To adjust for purpose; to adapt by forethought or calculation; to fit or prepare by the adaptation of means to an end.
#: {{co|en|to '''calculate''' a system of laws for the government and protection of a free people}}
#* {{RQ:Tillotson Works|sermon=IV|passage=[Religion] is {{...}} '''calculated''' for our benefit.}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=2004|author=Parliament of the United Kingdom|title=w:Gangmasters (Licensing) Act 2004|chapter=Section 1(3)|url=[s:Gangmasters (Licensing) Act 2004{{!}}Wikisource]|page=1|text={{w|Gangmasters and Labour Abuse Authority|The Authority}} may do anything that it considers is '''calculated''' to facilitate, or is incidental or conducive to, the carrying out of any of its functions.}}
# {{lb|en|chess}} To imagine sequences of potential moves and responses without actually moving the pieces.

====Conjugation====
{{en-conj|stem=calculat|old=1}}

====Synonyms====
* {{sense|determine value of or solution to}} {{l|en|compute}}, {{l|en|reckon}} {{qualifier|old}}, [[work out]]
* {{sense|determine values or solutions}} {{l|en|compute}}, {{l|en|reckon}} {{qualifier|old}}
